name: Fast Fuzzy Search – WordPress & WooCommerce Live Search
author: Khizar Hasan

sections.description:
Tired of slow or irrelevant WordPress search results?

Fast Fuzzy Search is a lightweight, privacy-focused plugin that replaces the default WordPress search with an instant, typo-friendly search bar that works out of the box.

Whether you’re running a blog, an online store, or a documentation portal, Fast Fuzzy Search ensures your visitors find what they’re looking for—fast.

Perfect for

  • WooCommerce stores
  • Blogs & content-heavy sites
  • Portfolios & project listings
  • Membership or internal knowledge bases
  • Agencies building client sites

Live Demo: Fast Fuzzy Search Live Demo

Features

  • Blazing Fast Fuzzy Search Engine – Typo-tolerant matching, even on massive sites.
  • WooCommerce-Optimized Search – Search products by name, SKU, category, tags, attributes.
  • Live AJAX Search – Instant results, no reloads.
  • Product Price & Thumbnail Display – Boost conversions with prices and images in results.
  • Smart Caching – File-based cache for thousands of posts/products.
  • Beautiful, Customizable UI – Choose Minimal, Material, Glassmorphic, Brutal. Customize colors, position, layout.
  • Shortcode + Auto Mode – Embed anywhere or auto-render sitewide.
  • Multiple Trigger Types – Floating button, input field, icon, or hybrid.
  • Responsive & Touch Friendly – Mobile-ready, works on all screens.
  • Custom Post Type Support – Search posts, pages, products, docs, properties, and more.
  • Advanced WooCommerce Integration – Index variations, show prices, pull categories/tags/attributes.
  • Multilingual-Ready – Compatible with Polylang.
  • Zero External Dependencies – No CDNs, trackers, or bloat. 100% self-contained.

Why Fast Fuzzy Search?

  • Instant AJAX Results – Lightning-fast feedback as you type
  • Typo-Tolerant Matching – “blu cap” still finds “blue cap”
  • Fully Self-Hosted – 100% of your data stays on your server
  • Zero Configuration – Install, activate, and go
  • Works with Polylang – Multilingual for Latin script languages
  • Lightweight & Performant – Optimized for 50,000+ posts
  • Built-In Styles – Drop-in themes included

Pro Version ($29)

  • Enhanced integration for WooCommerce, Easy Digital Downloads, Easy Property Listings
  • Search by SKU, tags, categories, attributes (color, size, etc.)
  • Premium themes & styling
  • Priority support

sections.installation:
1. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Customize under Settings > Fast Fuzzy Search.
  4. Optionally use [fast_fuzzy_search] shortcode to embed search manually.
sections.faq:
Is it compatible with WooCommerce?

Yes! Automatically detects and indexes WooCommerce products, SKUs, categories, tags, attributes, and prices.

Will it slow down my site?

No. Uses smart caching and loads asynchronously—built for performance.

Can I use it with a custom post type?

Yes. Supports all public post types by default; you can choose which to index.

Is it better than AJAX Search Pro?

If you want speed, simplicity, and WooCommerce-ready features out-of-the-box—yes.

How customizable is it?

Change colors, UI types, positioning, and more—no code needed.
